# AllKVD — Venkata Dhanush Kakarlamudi

**Venkata Dhanush Kakarlamudi** (also known as **Dhanush K**, **AllKVD**, or **kvdhanush06**) is a software engineer focused on backend systems, distributed architectures, high-throughput APIs, asynchronous worker queues, database performance, and AI-enabled developer products.

## Core Products & Web Applications

### CogniitSearch
- **URL:** https://cogniitsearch.allkvd.dev/
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/kvdhanush06/CogniitSearch
- **Description:** AI-powered answer and search platform combining web retrieval, source crawling, citation-aware synthesis, queue-backed workers, Redis caching, and streaming responses.

### TermsGuard
- **URL:** https://termsguard.allkvd.dev/
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/kvdhanush06/TermsGuard
- **Description:** AI-powered legal document analyzer for Terms of Service and Privacy Policies, producing structured clause analysis and actionable risk insights.

### AI Tools Directory
- **URL:** https://aitoolsdirectory.allkvd.dev/
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/kvdhanush06/ai-tools-directory
- **Description:** Searchable directory for discovering AI applications by category, use case, pricing, and practical guides.

### EduToolsHub
- **URL:** https://edutoolshub.onrender.com/
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/kvdhanush06/EduToolsHub
- **Description:** Education-focused workflow automation application integrating external services with timeout boundaries, validation, and structured fallbacks.

### SociaSphere
- **URL:** https://sociasphere.onrender.com/
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/kvdhanush06/SociaSphere
- **Description:** Social platform prototype focused on authenticated sessions, relational feed retrieval, and database query optimization.
